recommendedBaseline.verification: Google Pixel Support Team October 2026 announcement rendered and read via public-only CloakBrowser; cross-checked official Android 17 device support and Pixel security bulletin
recommendedBaseline.factoryDownloadTable: Official images page showed an acknowledgement gate; no acceptance clicked and no package downloaded. Exact selected build came from the independently accessible official support announcement.
recommendedBaseline.recommendation: Retain official Pixel base, SystemUI, lock screen, camera, and drivers; Taku takes Home and default assistant. First verify Quickstep/recents replacement, then full root and independent display.

alternatives.label: Official Pixel OS + root runtime
alternatives.pixelExperience: Retains SystemUI, lock screen, settings, Pixel Camera, and stock drivers; Taku replaces Pixel Launcher and Gemini.
alternatives.privilege: Root manager bootstraps on-device Broker/DisplayHost without Google platform private keys
alternatives.limit: Taku Launcher Quickstep/recents integration on Android 17 is unverified; full root and unchanged device certification cannot both be guaranteed.

alternatives.label: Official Pixel OS + ADB/Shizuku
alternatives.recommendation: Initial comparison probe and limited-privilege version
alternatives.pixelExperience: Taku can initially be selected as HOME/ASSISTANT; ordinary role changes do not completely remove stock recents dependencies.
alternatives.privilege: Shell permissions started through ADB/wireless debugging; not persistent full root
alternatives.limit: Verify virtual-display flag permissions, restart startup, and background behavior; not a complete privileged-distribution route

alternatives.label: LineageOS 23.2 / tokay
alternatives.recommendation: Alternative when framework changes are needed
alternatives.pixelExperience: Can retain some Pixel apps but is not the complete stock experience
alternatives.privilege: Can build/integrate custom system services, signatures, and sepolicy
alternatives.limit: Official device metadata currently lists branch 23.2 and requires Android 16 firmware before installation. Do not mix stock Android 17 packages with this baseline.

alternatives.label: GrapheneOS / Pixel 9
alternatives.pixelExperience: Pixel Camera and sandboxed Google Play can be installed; not the complete stock experience
alternatives.privilege: Forking/modifying assumes renewed compatibility and security-model maintenance responsibilities
alternatives.limit: Upstream emphasizes locked bootloader and verified boot; a persistent broadly privileged root Agent does not qualify for directly reusing its distribution-security guarantees

alternatives.label: AOSP / GSI
alternatives.pixelExperience: Generic system lacks the complete Pixel-specific experience
alternatives.limit: Needs device/firmware/app/visual integration; not the first route for preserving the stock experience

magisk.status: candidate only; release notes mention Android 16 QPR2 and higher Zygisk, not proof of the selected Android 17 build or Taku integration

scrcpy.status: diagnostic reference only; virtual-display docs support new-display, display-scoped app start and IME policy; no Pixel 9 test performed

migration.finding: sharedUserId=android.uid.system; build signs with public AOSP platform test key
migration.change: Remove system shared UID dependency; the Taku frontend requests HOME/ASSISTANT roles while a separate service performs privileged execution. Taku takes Home and assistant entries.

migration.finding: Root Broker accesses frontend private directories and runs chown system:system
migration.change: Reuse one Broker/queue, make queue persistence service-owned, and let the frontend submit/view tasks through authenticated IPC; remove dependence on system UID in app private directories
Use service.sh in a development root module, waiting for boot/user-unlock state; add SELinux rules based on actual denials and retain Enforcing

migration.finding: Mirror socket accepts only UID 0/1000/2000, rejecting an ordinary Taku APK
migration.change: Register/verify frontend UID/certificate and authorize through controlled IPC; do not expose a privileged entry open to every app

migration.finding: Reflection failure for trusted/own-focus/no-steal flags silently becomes 0
migration.change: Report individual flag/permission/functional checks at startup; explicitly fail or declare degradation when critical capabilities are missing; independently test main-display focus and background IME

migration.finding: Hard-coded AVD DNS 10.0.2.3 and requirement for adb root/remount
migration.change: For stock user builds, use root-manager transport and module installation; adapt to device network resolution and parameterize data/version paths

migration.finding: Current preview is approximately 5 fps JPEG
migration.change: Prioritize actual task screenshots/input; evaluate hardware MediaCodec for smooth preview later without adding scrcpy as a second persistent background-display implementation

migration.finding: Current Home is an independent Activity without Quickstep/recents-provider integration
migration.change: Implement Taku Launcher Home/recents on compatible Launcher3/Quickstep. Switching providers through a root module is a candidate requiring Android 17 SystemUI/gesture-animation verification before disabling stock Launcher.

validationGates.name: Stock baseline
validationGates.criteria: Verify tokay, Global build, SPL, and OEM-unlock capability; record screenshot/functional baselines for stock Home, lock screen, notifications, camera, calls, and network

validationGates.name: Stock virtual-display probe
validationGates.criteria: Use ADB + scrcpy only as a short comparison; verify dynamic display, launch one existing app, and check main-display focus/IME; remove displays when exiting

validationGates.name: Privileged runtime
validationGates.criteria: Device/build-matched root bootstrap; Broker boot startup, actual UID/SELinux, authenticated IPC, and device CLI; do not copy existing account credentials; verify Taku HOME/ASSISTANT and recents-provider identity/permissions/home gesture

validationGates.name: Independent phone execution
validationGates.criteria: Disconnect USB/computer; on-device Agent completes a task while the main display remains usable; verify real output, notifications, takeover/pause, and failure boundaries

validationGates.name: Display and app compatibility
validationGates.criteria: Test different apps, media, Chinese input, same-app singleTask migration/conflicts, screen-off, lock screen, and reboot separately. PID survival does not replace visual/task acceptance. Verify swipe-home, recents, and quick-switch after removing Pixel Launcher, with Gemini absent as assistant entry

validationGates.name: Updates and recovery
validationGates.criteria: Match boot images, root modules, service state, and official experience before/after A/B updates; reverify every version; restore with a currently compatible official package and confirm data/anti-rollback restrictions

boundaries: No Pixel 9 or other ADB device connected; no purchase, unlocking, flashing, root installation, sign-in, or firmware-download terms accepted.
Virtual displays share the Android system, app data, and accounts; they are not a second VM or independent copies of each app.
Full root, locked-bootloader hardware attestation, and retention of every stock feature cannot all be promised in advance.
The user explicitly rejects stock Pixel Launcher and Gemini. Taku should take HOME/ASSISTANT and recents; changing default HOME while retaining stock recents does not constitute complete replacement.

Distribute custom modules/APKs/source and reproducible installation materials; Google image terms restrict modification/redistribution, so these are not a directly open-source complete Taku ROM package.
The project internal license has not been changed to an open-source license.

purchaseAssessment.deviceClassVerdict: An unlockable Pixel 9 / tokay suits Taku development and flashing adaptation; official LineageOS metadata and GrapheneOS installation materials support alternative-OS routes.
purchaseAssessment.takuVerdict: There is no complete flashable Pixel 9 Taku package; the existing emulator system.img cannot be flashed directly. Agent, independent display, and Taku Quickstep are unverified on Pixel 9 hardware.
purchaseAssessment.recommendation: Choose Pixel 9 12GB/256GB without carrier restrictions or with proven unlockability. 128GB also works as a first development device; 256GB provides storage headroom.
